versions.changelog: Security hardening: require explicit invocation, pin faster-whisper version, and add dependency-review step before install.
Make package self-contained: include runtime scripts and requirements in skill bundle; update instructions to use packaged script paths.

Initial release of audio-srt-workflow skill.

- Generate or align SRT subtitles from audio, with or without a reference transcript.
- Supports SRT timing cleanup, quality checks, and subtitle preview video rendering.
- Offers both CLI, GUI, and Python API run styles.
- Requires Python 3.10+, ffmpeg, and faster-whisper.
- Includes workflows for audio with text (alignment) and audio only (auto-generation).
